page.notes: The Arabic is small and partly illegible on the scan. Marked [?] where uncertain: the name "Mahammed" (possibly Mohammed), the Arabic word after "اراد بنا", and the Arabic line "هو امر بيمن امريں" (rendered as read, may be a misprint). The Arabic line beginning "لا جبر ولا تفويض" is printed in reverse order at the start of the line; transcribed as read. The section mark "c" in the right margin is transcribed as a note. The bracket "]" after "AlShiis, &c." is printed. Possible printing errors (left as printed): "Esse" written as "Esse", "ratio" words in brackets are printed as they stand.
